tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a saturating response consistent with a supply-limited bridge, but the recalled note points to an unspecified two-layer mechanism. A discriminating probe is needed before fitting a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary saturating response to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The rows vary only u_now, leaving the effects of the other inputs and the bridge dynamics unidentified.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and better suited to distinguishing the unresolved mechanism.
It is not relevant to identifying the target mechanism.
